sections.heading: OBJECTIVE
items: Registered nutritionist with a background in clinical and community health settings, seeking a client-facing role where I can apply evidence-based dietary counseling to support individuals in achieving sustainable, long-term health outcomes. Passionate about meeting patients where they are and committed to delivering culturally sensitive, personalized nutrition guidance that is both scientifically grounded and practically achievable.

items.title: Clinical Nutritionist, Lakewood Center
items.subtitle: TX
bullets: Provides individualized nutrition counseling to a caseload of 40+ patients weekly, with a focus on chronic disease management including diabetes, hypertension, and obesity.
Develops personalized meal plans aligned with medical guidelines and patient lifestyle, regularly collaborating with physicians and care coordinators to ensure integrated treatment.
Tracks patient progress through quarterly assessments and adjusts dietary recommendations based on lab results and self-reported outcomes.

items.title: Nutrition Assistant, St. Raphael Hospital
items.subtitle: TX
bullets: Supported registered dietitians in conducting nutritional screenings and developing care plans for inpatient populations across oncology and cardiac wards.
Assisted in delivering group nutrition education sessions for patients and caregivers, covering topics including heart-healthy eating and post-surgical dietary transitions.

items.title: Community Nutrition Outreach Program
bullets: Designed a 6-week group nutrition education series targeting low-income households in Houston neighborhoods, reaching 80+ participants across four community centers.
Post-program surveys showed a 45% increase in participant confidence.
